artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan landing prop:archimedean in full generality: the order lemma and frame-property bridge in FormalSystem.Semantics, a new Metalogic/Independence/ArchimedeanSharpness.lean carrying both countermodels with 14 pinned declarations, the prose amendments at the three sites that today promise the theorem, and a final full-gate phase with generated-count regeneration.

memory_candidates.content: When a research report is written before a sibling task lands in the same files, re-derive the report's 'what must be added' list against the tree at plan time, not just its 'what exists' list. Measured case: a sibling commit landed isDiscrete_iff_exists_isLeast_pos (a biconditional between the pointwise Discrete clause and the least-positive-element form) three commits before planning, which made two of the report's four planned hypothesis-entry wrappers one-line applications of an existing lemma. Reading the target files' current declaration outline (grep for ^theorem/^def plus the module docstring's Main results list) costs two tool calls and removes a whole class of duplicate-declaration defects that no gate catches.
